basis.title: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Commercial Packaged Boilers (final rule), 85 FR 1592, January 10, 2020
basis.by: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy
basis.label: Lifetime: "a retirement function ... with a resulting mean lifetime of 24.8 years"
basis.note: Printed page 1634. DOE applies one lifetime to every commercial packaged boiler class, which includes hot-water condensing and steam boilers. Not specific to either. Also stated on p.3 (printed 1594).

basis.title: Purchasing Energy-Efficient Boilers (web page, modified 2026-09-09)
basis.by: U.S. Department of Energy, Federal Energy Management Program
basis.label: Assumed boilers operate for 1,500 full-load hours per year and have a lifetime of 25 years.
basis.note: Small commercial (Table 3, 300,000-2,500,000 Btu/h, 94-98% thermal efficiency examples) and large commercial (Table 4, 1,400 h, also 25 years) hot-water boilers; the efficient examples are condensing. Table 2 (residential boilers) uses 20 years. Not for steam.

basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Boilers
basis.note: Printed page 44. Boilers, type not stated. Asset category 'Boilers and heaters (where not industry specified)'. Printed DV 8%, SL 6%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Boilers (packaged)
basis.note: Printed page 44. Packaged boilers, hot water or steam not stated. Asset category 'Boilers and heaters (where not industry specified)'. Printed DV 13%, SL 8.5%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

basis.title: Future Buildings Standard: final stage impact assessment (RPC-MHCLG-25104-IA), 24 March 2026
basis.by: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (UK)
basis.label: "15 years for gas boilers"
basis.note: Printed page 77. Gas boilers in new non-domestic buildings (hot water; condensing by current regulations, so the condensing match is the stronger one). Assumption for new non-domestic buildings in England; the IA says the lifetimes are in line with BS EN 15459 (Annex/Appendix E), but they are stated as the department's own modelling assumptions, not a reproduced table. Round-number economic-appraisal assumptions, not observed lives. Same values as the January 2021 Future Buildings Standard consultation IA (separate file), so the two are not independent.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
